name: llm-harness-plugins
description: Cross-platform plugins for LLM coding agents

plugins.name: agentmem
plugins.description: Persistent file-based memory system — ADD-only, multi-signal retrieval, hierarchical scoping. One Java core, OpenCode + Claude Code + Pi backends.

plugins.name: agentinsights
plugins.description: Session analytics + AI-generated narrative reports — scan transcripts, extract facets via LLM, generate HTML insights report with charts and suggestions.

plugins.name: general-skills
plugins.description: Generic, reusable audit/quality skills for any project — config, redundancy, logic, math, style, cross-refs, citations, proofs, review-convergence. 10 agents across 11 subskills. Domain-agnostic agents, format-aware cross-ref checker.

plugins.name: typst-toolkit
plugins.description: Typst-specific tools — syntax fixer, formatting-fixer, xref checker, citation checker, production readiness, diagram checker. 6 agents across 6 subskills.

plugins.name: latex-toolkit
plugins.description: LaTeX-specific tools — syntax fixer, formatting-fixer, xref checker, citation checker, production readiness, figure captions, index auditor, notation checker. 8 agents across 8 subskills.

plugins.name: knowledge-graph
plugins.description: Build-time knowledge graph from Typst source — deterministic derivation, Leiden community detection, GraphRAG-style hierarchical retrieval, cross-project (IVP + ME/CFS), auto-injected agent context
